_note: Curated for the hackathon demo. Keyed by destination country (lowercase), then by nationality (lowercase). This is a static, vetted lookup table — NOT a live API. State this honestly to judges. Verify against official sources before real travel.

vietnamese.summary: Vietnamese citizens are visa-free in Thailand for tourism up to 30 days.
vietnamese.advisory: Exchange to Thai Baht before you go — airport rates are usually worse. Carry proof of onward travel.

default.summary: Requirements vary by nationality; verify with the Thai embassy.
default.advisory: Confirm current entry rules before booking.

vietnamese.summary: Vietnamese citizens generally need a visa for mainland China; apply before departure.
vietnamese.advisory: Processing can take several business days. Some regions/transit routes have visa-free windows — verify current policy for your specific route and dates.

default.summary: Most nationalities require a visa for mainland China; verify with the Chinese embassy.
default.advisory: Apply well in advance; requirements change — confirm current rules.

vietnamese.summary: Vietnamese citizens require a B1/B2 visitor visa; Vietnam is not part of the US Visa Waiver Program (no ESTA).
vietnamese.advisory: Apply early — interview wait times can be long. Entry rules change; verify current requirements on the official US embassy site before booking.

default.summary: Requirements depend on nationality; VWP countries use ESTA, others need a visa.
default.advisory: Check whether your nationality qualifies for ESTA or requires a full visa.
